extracted.name: Stuffed Poblano peppers
extracted.description: Great recipe for Stuffed Poblano peppers.
instruction_lines: Cook tomato on medium heat, add oil
Add onion and squash, saute add chive butter, badia seasoning. Cook 5 or so min stirring
Add cooked warmed rice and dry and liquid chicken seasoning
Roast Poblano in air fryer 8 mins 400 degrees, let cool
Slice the middle of the pepper open And stuff peppers with rice mixture
Top with sliced jalepeno, Cook in air fryer for 3 mins
